SELECT folder_idx, folder_nm, sort_order, CAST(use_yn AS VARCHAR) AS use_yn, CAST(owner_view_yn AS VARCHAR) AS owner_view_yn, CAST(staff_view_yn AS VARCHAR) AS staff_view_yn FROM bbs_folder WHERE folder_idx = #{folderIdx}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bbs_folder ( folder_nm, sort_order, use_yn, owner_view_yn, staff_view_yn, created_by, updated_at ) VALUES ( TRIM(#{folderNm}), COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, 0), COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{useYn}), ''), 'Y'), COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{ownerViewYn}), ''), 'Y'), COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{staffViewYn}), ''), 'Y'), #{userId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE bbs_folder SET folder_nm = TRIM(#{body.folderNm}), sort_order = COALESCE(#{body.sortOrder}, sort_order), use_yn = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{body.useYn}), ''), use_yn), owner_view_yn = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{body.ownerViewYn}), ''), owner_view_yn), staff_view_yn = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{body.staffViewYn}), ''), staff_view_yn), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE folder_idx = #{folderIdx}
